thread:
Elaine: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands about customer wins/losses. Drop super short notes on why we won or lost deals and the top asks you keep hearing.

Sam: Won a mid-market deal last week. Key win signals: predictable latency + token-level billing transparency. Prospect said 'we could estimate cost per feature' :tada:

Maria: Lost three enterprise RFPs this quarter. Primary blockers: no VPC/on-prem option in the RFP, and KMS/HSM integration requests from security were redlines.

Raj: Repeating what engineering sees: performance + reliability = close. But legal/procurement timelines and audit controls are the gating factors for enterprise.

Ana: From CS: recurring customer ask — safer rollouts. They want canary traffic splits, observable diffs for quality regressions, and auto-rollback options in the Console.

Leo: Marketing note: we have a strong narrative for Dedicated (<50ms median in our benchmarks) — one startup asked for a case study this week.

Sam: Another loss theme: buyers struggle with pricing predictability. They want committed capacity options that map to their peak usage patterns and clear unit economics. We should surface Dedicated/commit options earlier in the funnel.

Elaine: Actionable asks I'm hearing: 1) Can we accelerate Private pilot GA timeline? 2) Add canary rollout UI + auto-rollback capability. 3) Per-route cost breakdown and token attribution in Console.

Maria: Product/PM note: Private is gated on infra work for networking and KMS integrations. Can leadership approve a pilot SLA for select customers to unblock sales? @Raj

Raj: We can offer a limited Private pilot with manual ops support (M-F) for a handful of customers; not full GA. Need to scope which customers and capacity.

Ana: I'll own a single point of contact for those pilots; will draft a short onboarding/checklist for sales and CS.

Sam: Please also prep a one-pager: 'Why Redwood Dedicated vs self-hosting' — include economic comparisons and integration effort. That'd speed enterprise conversations.

Elaine: Next steps: Maria to propose timeline by EOD Tue. Raj to confirm pilot capacity by Wed. Ana to draft pilot checklist. Sam to compile top-5 objection-response scripts. I'll escalate budget ask to leadership.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Note: doc 'dedicated-pilot-checklist' created in /docs/pilot/ — link: https://redwood.internal/docs/pilot/dedicated-pilot-checklist

Leo: Also ask: PMs/CS — can you share anonymized win/loss quotes and a one-paragraph summary for marketing assets?

Ana: Will post a short template in #customer-success by EOD for quotes and permission tracking.

Sam: Thanks all, will follow up with a prioritized list of accounts to target for pilots. :thumbsup:
